Home

Sustaining Literacy Routines

Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This credential recognizes your full participation in the Literacy th@t Works spring online course modules. By completing all modules, earning each badge and microcredential, and engaging in reflection and discussion, you have demonstrated a sustained commitment to literacy routines and practicing teacher inquiry. This credential signifies your accomplishment in completing the spring semester coursework and your readiness to carry these practices forward into your classroom and future professional learning.

Criteria

Earn all the micro credentials and badges in the Cultivating Literacy Routines course.

  • Everyday Sparks 2.0

  • Everyday Sparks 2.0 Discussion

  • Joining a Conversation

  • Joining a Conversation Discussion

  • Layering Reading, Writing and Discussion

  • Layering Reading, Writing and Discussion Discussion

  • Teacher as Researcher | Sustaining Literacy Routines

  • Teacher as Researcher Discussion
